learnings.insight: Always use count_nonspace (strips all whitespace) for length checks, never wc -m or len(text)

Phase 7 final.md must satisfy BOTH rhythm_fit (line-based) AND mobile_paragraph_metrics (paragraph-based) simultaneously. Solution: use draft.md's multi-sentence lines as paragraphs, separated by blank lines, with sentence-splitting only for lines that would exceed mobile_paragraph allowance
quality-report.json mechanism_fidelity and soul_fidelity need {status: 'pass/fail', items: [...]} format, not flat dicts
QUESTION_WORD_META_RE triggers on question words (什么/为什么/是不是 etc.) in non-quoted lines. Watch for narrative use of these words
导语 must be split into 2-5 separate text_paragraphs (blank-line separated) with first starting '导语：' and total ≥60 nonspace chars
To control quote_line_rate, split long narrative lines at sentence boundaries to increase non-quote line denominator
